methods.description: Identify intervals, lines and rays from endpoints and arrows; name them using capital letters, with a ray endpoint first and reversible names for intervals and lines.
Name the vertex and arms and write three-letter angle names with the vertex in the middle; use either order of the outer letters and other points on the same arms.
Read matching interval ticks and angle arcs and state the equal intervals or angles using the named points.
